cohort: The study included 50 pregnant women diagnosed with pre-eclampsia and 50 normal pregnant women of similar age group.
finding: Preeclamptic pregnant women had significantly higher mean serum concentrations of uric acid compared to normal pregnant women, but no statistically significant difference was found for serum creatinine levels.
cross-section timing: During the pre-eclamptic state, defined as after 20 weeks of gestation.
gest_age: After 20 weeks of gestation (for the pre-eclamptic group)
